title: “Realizing Your Potential” SCA Shabbat Message by Albert Saad

chapters.title: Aharon and Moshe in Parashat Va'eira
chapters.about: Rashi asking why Aharon is listed before Moshe

chapters.title: Measuring Accomplishments and Potential
chapters.about: Rambam on Moshe, absolute scale, and subjective method

chapters.title: The Story of the Vilna Gaon
chapters.about: Beit Din Shel Ma'ala and evaluating one's potential

summary: Albert Saad discusses a question from Rashi on Parashat Va'eira regarding Aharon and Moshe being listed as equal. He presents the absolute scale and the subjective method of evaluating a person's potential and accomplishments. He also shares a story from the Vilna Gaon about Beit Din Shel Ma'ala.
questions: Why is Aharon's name listed in front of Moshe's in Parashat Va'eira?
How can Aharon be considered equal to Moshe?
What is the subjective method of evaluating potential?
What question will be asked at Beit Din Shel Ma'ala according to the Vilna Gaon?
